title: Safegate pattern
description: A pattern describes HOW to read one capability from one contract shape. It is pure data. It never decides whether the result is good or bad, only where to look and how to interpret the raw bytes.

id.description: Stable identifier. Must match the filename.

capability.description: Which capability this pattern reads. Signals map capabilities to axes; patterns never do.

method.description: The deterministic read. Exactly one of storageSlot, callSelector, accountField, or extension.

slotDerivation.description: Human-readable derivation of the slot constant, so a reviewer can recompute it.

callSelector.description: For kind=call-selector. First 4 bytes of keccak256 of the signature.

accountField.description: For kind=account-field. Dotted path into the parsed account data.

extension.description: For kind=account-extension. The Token-2022 extension name exactly as the RPC returns it in the parsed `extension` field, e.g. permanentDelegate. Case-sensitive.

extensionField.description: For kind=account-extension. The field to read inside that extension's `state` object, e.g. delegate. Omit when presenceIndicatedBy is extension-present.

callArgs.description: For kind=call-selector: fixed ABI-encoded arguments appended to the selector, in whole 32-byte words. Only with presenceIndicatedBy=call-success, because the value returned for a dummy argument means nothing; the function answering is the finding.

detects.description: Plain English: what a positive read means. No judgement language.

nonEmptyMeans.description: Whether a non-empty read means the capability EXISTS or is explicitly disabled. Default capability-present.

presenceIndicatedBy.description: How presence is determined. 'non-empty-value' means the RETURNED VALUE decides, so owner() returning the zero address means renounced. 'call-success' means the FUNCTION EXISTING decides, regardless of what it returns: paused() returning false still proves a pause mechanism exists, and capability is what gets scored, not current state. 'extension-present' is the Solana counterpart: a Token-2022 extension being configured on the mint proves the mechanism, so a transfer fee currently set to 0 basis points is still a fee mechanism with a live authority behind it. Defaults to non-empty-value.

knownFalseNegative.description: A documented case where relying on this pattern ALONE gives the wrong answer. This field is why the dictionary exists.

coversExamples.description: Real verified addresses this pattern correctly reads. Used as regression fixtures.

rationale.description: Why this pattern is needed and what breaks without it.
